description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the recent sequence ratio (in percentage) and two metrics—perplexity and GPU memory ratio—across different configurations of the PyramidInfer system. The x-axis represents the recent sequence ratio, ranging from 0% to 100% in increments of 20%, and is plotted on a linear scale. The left y-axis, labeled "Perplexity," ranges from 4.2 to 4.7, while the right y-axis, labeled "GPU Mem. Ratio (%)," ranges from 40% to 100%. The plot includes four distinct lines: "Perplexity" (orange, solid line with circular markers), "Full Cache PPL" (red, dashed line), "GPU Mem. Ratio" (blue, solid line with circular markers), and "Full Cache GPU Mem." (blue, dashed line). As the recent sequence ratio increases, the perplexity initially decreases sharply from approximately 4.6 to 4.3 between 0% and 40%, then fluctuates slightly around 4.3–4.4 before rising again to about 4.4 at 100%. In contrast, the GPU memory ratio remains relatively stable at around 50% until the recent sequence ratio reaches 80%, where it sharply increases to nearly 100% at 100%. The "Full Cache PPL" line remains constant at approximately 4.35, and the "Full Cache GPU Mem." line stays flat at 100%, indicating the baseline performance without compression.
